allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Axita Cotton Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of Grant of Stock Options under the Axita Cotton Employee Stock Option Plan 2023 ( ESOP 2023  or  Scheme ) of Axita Cotton Limited ( the Company ).

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Axita Cotton Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 178200 equity shares pursuant to the ESOP scheme of the Company.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Axita Cotton Limited has informed the Exchange about approval of the Allotment of Bonus Shares, in the ratio of 1:10, to eligible Members whose names appeared in the Register as on Friday, February 13, 2026 being the record date fixed for this purpose and other business.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Axita Cotton Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the approval of grant of 1,72,000 stock options to the eligible employees under the terms of "Axita Cotton Employee Stock Options Plan 2023".
